# Beam AI

> > Beam AI provides AI-powered automated takeoff and measurement software for construction estimators, contractors, suppliers, and facility managers.

Beam AI (ibeam.ai) leverages artificial intelligence to automate material takeoffs and quantity measurements from construction plans and aerial imagery, helping contractors reduce estimation time by up to 90% while improving bid accuracy. The platform serves subcontractors across trades including demolition, rebar, earthwork, utilities, and facilities maintenance.

- AI Takeoff Software
- Construction Estimating

## Products & Solutions

- [AI Takeoff Software for Suppliers & Distributors](https://www.ibeam.ai/suppliers-and-distributors): Beam AI automated takeoff software for suppliers and distributors
- [Demolition Takeoff Software for Contractors](https://www.ibeam.ai/subcontractors/demolition): Automated demolition takeoff software for contractors with 90% time savings
- [Facilities Maintenance Takeoff Software](https://www.ibeam.ai/field-services/facilities-maintenance): AI aerial measurements for facilities maintenance across portfolio sites
